messages:
sam: quick note — found parity gap: REST accepts X-Impersonate header, Node SDK drops it on retry.

sam: curl repro:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Impersonate: user:99" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```

sam: Node snippet (loses header on retry):
```js
client.chat.create({ messages, headers: { 'X-Impersonate': 'user:99' } })
```

lina_dev: That breaks our sample-app e2e impersonation tests. Can we keep headers across retries?

mike_platform: We sanitize headers and retry builder reconstructs request without custom headers. Security choice but poor parity.

mike_platform: Plan: add explicit param chat.create({ impersonate: 'user:99' }) mapped server-side, and preserve across retries. Also add opt-in rawHeaders config for advanced users.

sam: favor explicit param for auditing. also add tests and changelog note.

ci-bot: e2e flake matches header-loss-on-retry in pipeline #8190.

lina_dev: Please RFC + PR; backport to patch if possible.

mike_platform: Will open RFC + PR today; thanks.
